title: Turning Tides: 11th and 12th Centuries: inquiry into evidence and interpretation
chapterConnection: This project extends the learning of 'Turning Tides: 11th and 12th Centuries' by investigating evidence and interpretation in a fresh context.
question: What can we discover about evidence and interpretation if we observe, compare or model it outside the textbook?
deliverable: Learner-created report, model, poster, presentation, data display or portfolio.
reflection: What did the investigation change about your understanding of evidence and interpretation?
